sources.title: Sources and copyright
sources.disclaimer: This platform is an independent community project. It is not affiliated with, nor endorsed by, ISTQB® or the Turkish Testing Board. The content is written from scratch against the official syllabus and does not reproduce exam questions. No guarantee is given regarding your exam result. For official and current information, see istqb.org and turkishtestingboard.org.
sources.privacyBody: No account, no server, no analytics. All your progress is stored only in your own browser's IndexedDB and is never sent anywhere. Clearing your browser data also clears your progress.
